equivalents.note: The Tibetan has dngos po 'thing' for bhāba and dngos po med pa 'non-thing' for abhāba, and turns both verbs (hoi 'becomes', jāi 'goes') into a plain 'is not' (ma yin).

The Tibetan has sangs rgyas 'buddha' where the Bengali has saṃbohem̐ '(in such) awakening', and its comment has rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'perfect buddha' for Munidatta's sambodhane (cp.29.m2), as if both read saṃbuddha.
The line has mtshon du med 'cannot be indicated', a flat negative where dulakkha means 'hard to discern'; the comment has the closer mtshon par dka' ba (cp.29.m3).
The comment renders Munidatta's varṇacihnarūpa as mtshan ma'i gzugs 'the form of the mark', leaving out colour (cp.29.m4).
The comment has lung dang bstan bcos for Munidatta's āgamaśāstra, splitting the compound into scripture and treatise (cp.29.m4).

The Tibetan makes the continuum the place in which shapes (dbyibs, its own addition) such as long, short and round are not known, rather than one member of the compound; rgyud is also its word for 'tantra' and 'string'.
For bhāvasvarūpa the Tibetan has ngo bo nyid kyi rang bzhin, with ngo bo nyid 'essence' rather than dngos po for bhāva.
Here and in cp.29.m4 the comment has de nyid, where cp.29.m2 and cp.29.m5 have de kho na nyid.
The Tibetan renders pratibhāsa as gzugs brnyan 'reflection, image', in keeping with the moon in water, not as snang ba 'appearance'.
Here ngo bo, where cp.29.m3 and cp.29.m5 have rang bzhin for svarūpa.

questions: road (cp.29.2a): not matched. Where the Bengali has baṭa, the Tibetan line has rmongs pa 'fool, deluded one', apparently reading the word as an address to a novice, in line with Munidatta's bālayogin (cp.29.m3; Tibetan byis pa'i rnal 'byor pa); the line has no word for 'road', so it is worth checking whether baṭa means 'road' here at all.

vijnana (cp.29.2a): not matched. The Tibetan line has no word for consciousness (rnam shes); by position biṇāṇā corresponds to ya mtshan 'wonder', perhaps from a different reading, and Munidatta's paraphrase puts tattva (Tibetan de nyid) in its place (cp.29.m3).

mandala (cp.29.m3): left out as a false match. মণ্ডল sits inside parimaṇḍala 'round' (dīrgha-hrasva-parimaṇḍala, 'long, short, round'), which the Tibetan renders zlum po; neither is the tantric maṇḍala.
river (cp.29.m3): left out as a false match. নদী sits inside সন্তানদীর্ঘ (santāna-dīrgha, 'continuum, long'); the passage names no river.

Not answered again in the commentary, because the verse line already gives the same word: bhava-abhava in cp.29.m2 (dngos po, dngos po med pa), lila in cp.29.m3 (rnam par rol pa), agama and cihna in cp.29.m4 (lung, mtshan ma'i).
